sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
Shooting Range's core gameplay mechanics are simple yet addictive. Players control a character who appears at the top of the screen, with a range of targets moving across the screen below. The player must use their mouse, keyboard, or touch controls to shoot at the targets, scoring points as they go. The game's speed and difficulty level can be adjusted to suit the player's skill level, making it accessible to players of all ages and abilities. One of the most interesting features of Shooting Range is its use of points multipliers. Each target has its own unique zone, which can be activated by hitting it with a shot. When activated, the points multiplier will increase the score earned for hitting subsequent targets in the same zone. Players can use this feature to their advantage by targeting specific zones and maximizing their score.

The targets in Shooting Range are also a key part of the game's addictive gameplay. Each target has its own unique characteristics, such as speed, size, and points value. Players must use their wits and reflexes to outmaneuver the targets, using the right combination of speed and accuracy to maximize their score. The game also features a range of special targets, such as targets that explode on contact or targets that release power-ups. These special targets add an extra layer of complexity and challenge to the game, making it even more addictive and engaging.

Overall, Shooting Range's core gameplay mechanics are simple yet addictive. With its intuitive controls, colorful visuals, and endless opportunities for improvement, Shooting Range is a game that's perfect for anyone looking for a fun and challenging browser game.
